sentences.text:
Arvind Varse vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 10 February,
2025
 Neutral Citation No. 2025:Mphc-Jbp:6196
 1 
 In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
At Jabalpur

Before
 Hon'Ble Shri Justice Pramod Kumar Agrawal

On The 10 th Of February, 2025
 Misc. Criminal Case No. 50567 of 2024
 Arvind Varse
 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh
 Appearance:
 Shri Aishwarya Sahu - Advocate for the applicant.
 Shri C.M. Tiwari - Government Advocate for the responde
 Order

This is the first application filed by the applicant under Section 483 of the BNSS/439 of Cr.P.C. for grant of regular bail relating to Crime No. 372/2024 registered at Police Station - Junnardev,
District Chhindwara (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Section 420, 467, 468, 471, 34 of IPC.

Applicant is in detention since 19.10.2024.
2.

As per the prosecution story, the allegation against the applicant is that he alongwith co-accused persons prepared the forged voter IDs of customers and misappropriated the total amount of Rs.
64,21,637/- to the Bank/complainant.
On the basis of which, offence was registered against the present applicant and co- accused persons under aforesaid sections.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant is innocent and he has been falsely implicated in this case.
He is in jail since 19.10.2024.
It is submitted that co-accused Rajni, Sonam Thakur, Parveen and Rehana Sheikh have been enlarged on bail by the trial court.
Charge-sheet has been filed.
There is no NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:6196 2 MCRC-50567-2024 criminal antecedents of the applicant.
The trial of the case will take considerable time.
Therefore, it has been prayed that the applicant may be released on bail pending the trial.
4. On the other hand, learned counsel for State has opposed the grant of bail to the applicant.
5. Having taken into consideration all the facts and circumstances of the case, but without commenting on merit of the case, I am inclined to release the applicant on bail.

Consequently, bail application under Section 483 of BNSS/439 of Cr.P.C. for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicant,
stands allowed.
